__inputs.label: Gateway job name (app.kubernetes.io/instance by default)
__inputs.description: The name of the gateway to monitor

description: Per-stage request lifecycle latency for Conduktor Gateway (ADR-0015).

options.content:
**Request lifecycle latency** — one panel per T0→T10 stage from ADR-0015. Requires the gateway feature flag `GATEWAY_FEATURE_FLAGS_LIFECYCLE_METRICS=true`; with it off, panels are empty.

**Reading gaps (ADR §7):** a missing/zero series means traffic didn't reach that stage, not that instrumentation is broken. Cache hits skip `upstreamwait`/rebuilder (healthy); `acks=0` produce skips `total`; a ~30s `total` spike with no `upstreamwait` is an upstream timeout.

**Percentiles (ADR §4):** buckets start at 1ms, so P99 reads flat for the sub-ms stages until they degrade; use mean and max for those, P99 for `upstreamwait`.

panels.description: Full-pipeline latency (gateway.request.total.duration). Left axis (seconds): mean and max, both exact. Right axis: '% over 1s', the exact fraction of requests slower than 1s (a real ladder bound) — an honest end-to-end tail signal replacing the interpolated p99 (ADR §4). A ~30s spike with no upstreamwait count is an upstream timeout (ADR §7 #6).
panels.title: Total request latency (T0→T10)

panels.description: Stacked mean latency per lifecycle stage — the dominant band is the bottleneck. Interceptor stages are per-invocation means (their _count is interceptors run, not requests, ADR §1); use the Interceptors section for per-interceptor attribution.
panels.title: Where the time goes (mean per stage)

panels.description: Recording rate per stage. A missing/zero series means traffic didn't reach that stage (ADR §7), e.g. cache hits skip upstreamwait; interceptor rates count invocations, not requests.
panels.title: Per-stage throughput (samples/s)

panels.description: Share of samples slower than 100ms per stage. 100ms is a real bucket bound so this is exact (no interpolation, ADR §4). Use it to spot which stage breached the SLO.
panels.title: Fraction over 100ms per stage

panels.description: Apdex latency-satisfaction score per stage (1.0 = all fast, 0 = all frustrated). T=100ms: satisfied ≤100ms, tolerating ≤500ms, frustrated above — computed from exact bucket counts (no interpolation). Fast self-performed stages sit at ~1.0; a dip flags a degrading stage (upstreamwait is the usual mover).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(gateway_request_preprocess_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_preprocess_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_preprocess_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_request_authorization_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_authorization_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_authorization_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_request_interceptor_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_interceptor_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_interceptor_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_request_rebuilder_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_rebuilder_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_rebuilder_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamqueue_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamqueue_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamqueue_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamwait_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamwait_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_request_upstreamwait_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(gateway_response_rebuilder_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(gateway_response_rebuilder_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5", job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (2 * sum(rate(gateway_response_rebuilder_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Left axis (seconds): mean and max, both exact at any magnitude. Right axis: '% over 500ms', the exact fraction of requests slower than 500ms — an honest tail signal that replaces the interpolated p99, which can overshoot on the coarse ladder (ADR §4). Serialize + hop to event loop + head-of-line wait + socket write. A spike usually means head-of-line blocking behind a slow earlier request on the same connection, not a slow client (ADR §1). Not a delivery signal.

targets.expr: sum by(interceptor) (rate(gateway_request_interceptor_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key", interceptor=~"$interceptor"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by(interceptor) (rate(gateway_request_interceptor_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", pod=~"$pod", api_key=~"$api_key", interceptor=~"$interceptor"}[$__rate_interval]))
